scope: Sealed existing-V2 inspection, same-loaded-record recovery, write-free settled confirmation and narrow same-pair resizable target
wire_boundary: Existing V1/V2 grammar, digests, markers and V1 recovery behavior unchanged. CheckedV2 reuses the existing loader; loaded recovery body extracted without changing effects.
capability_boundary: Only active target borrow receives ResizableDurableStorage; journal and retired confirmation remain ordinary views. Same retained descriptor and loaned journal, with no reopen/reload/replacement.
failure_scope: Resize failure before/partial/after effects, target sync, final marker sync and retired garbage cleanup retain lease and correctly qualified known or unknown outcomes.
limits: macOS filesystem runtime only; Linux and Windows runtime not established.
Generic image integrity and namespace handling supply no native Access mutation authority.
Native allocation intent, full-image reconstruction and actual native host saves require separate acceptance.
No physical power-loss or native Access mixed-client qualification.
